questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with appropriate inversion.

The committee meeting was so lengthy that we were all exhausted by the end.
options: The committee meeting was so lengthy that we were all exhausted by the end.
So lengthy was the committee meeting that we were all exhausted by the end.
We were all exhausted by the end because the committee meeting was so lengthy.
Lengthy was the committee meeting, exhausting us all by the end.
questions.answer: So lengthy was the committee meeting that we were all exhausted by the end.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location of the incident?
options: It was in the old warehouse that the accident occurred.
The accident occurred was in the old warehouse.
The old warehouse was where the accident occurred.
Where the accident occurred was the old warehouse.
questions.answer: It was in the old warehouse that the accident occurred.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation.

If I _____ more time, I would travel the world.
options: If I _____ more time, I would travel the world.
If I had _____ more time, I would travel the world.
If I were _____ more time, I would travel the world.
If I had been _____ more time, I would travel the world.
questions.answer: If I had _____ more time, I would travel the world.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly employs ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?

She enjoys painting and _____ music.
options: She enjoys painting and _____ music.
She enjoys painting and _____ music.
She enjoys painting and _____ music.
She enjoys painting and _____ music.

questions.question:
Identify the correct formal register sentence for a scientific report.

It is recommended that the experiment _____ repeated with a larger sample size.
options: It is recommended that the experiment _____ repeated with a larger sample size.
It is recommended that the experiment _____ repeated with a larger sample size.
It is recommended that the experiment _____ repeated with a larger sample size.
It is recommended that the experiment _____ repeated with a larger sample size.
questions.answer: It is recommended that the experiment _____ repeated with a larger sample size.
